sql: SELECT r.pmid, r.title, r.firstPublicationDate, regexp_extract(r.abstractText, '([^.]*10[^.]*)', 1) AS sentence FROM papers LATERAL VIEW explode(resultList.result) AS r WHERE r.pmid = '21602519' AND r.abstractText LIKE '%10%' LIMIT 5
